newsitem.title: FRANCE: OLYMPICS-LOURDES CONSIDERING WINTER GAMES BID.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-LOURDES CONSIDERING WINTER GAMES BID.

text.p: The French town of Lourdes is planning to launch a bid to host the Winter Olympics in 2006 or 2010.

French culture minister and Lourdes mayor Philippe Douste-Blazy said the famous Christian pilgrimage site, surrounded by ski resorts, could offer plenty of hotel rooms and an international airport located in nearby Tarbes.
Douste-Blazy said he had talked about the planned bid with French sports minister Guy Drut, who was studying the project.
